# skycloak_cluster_versions (Data Source)

Keycloak versions available for a cluster type.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "skycloak_cluster_versions" "keycloak" {
  type = "keycloak"
}

output "latest_keycloak_version" {
  value = data.skycloak_cluster_versions.keycloak.versions[0]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `type` (String) Cluster type (`keycloak`, `tidecloak`).

### Read-Only

- `versions` (List of String) Supported versions, newest first.
